shortDescription: A Swiss parliamentary committee's proposal to allow UBS BX:0UB to use Additional Tier 1 bonds to meet some of its capital requirements under new banking rules is a compromise the bank can live with, UBS Chairman Colm Kelleher said on Thursday.
